verdict.rationale: First-party docs repeatedly describe drop-in prebuilt `<SignIn/>`, `<SignUp/>` and profile/security-management components, offered on all plans. The docs also claim the components can be branded with any CSS library and deployed to your own domain. GitHub and llms.txt corroborate the sign-up, sign-in and profile-management focus, and a community user praises the Next.js integration. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Clerk-hosted pages, in-depth documentation or hands-on proof of how far UI customization goes.
